name: Porter

modes.label: Native service
modes.note: Hardware and complete resource tariff unverified.

modes.label: Porter Sandboxes (AWS, in your own account)
modes.note: Container sandboxes on a Karpenter node group of local-NVMe EC2 instances in the customer's AWS account. The Porter platform fee ($0.019/vCPU-h + $0.009/GB-h on requested resources) presumably applies, but no sandbox-specific pricing is published. EC2 cost is extra. Warm pods 'reserve their CPU and memory on the sandbox node group even while idle', so idle warm-pool capacity costs EC2 money. Default Max CPU is 20 cores per sandbox node group (queued beyond that; raise it self-serve). Max single sandbox 256 cores / 1 TB. Warm-pool pod size 0.1–16 CPU, 64 MiB–32 GiB. TTL is optional. Azure/GCP are beta on request.

plans.name: Standard
plans.note: Metered: $13/vCPU-month ($0.019/h) + $6/GB-RAM-month ($0.009/h) on requested app resources, prorated to the minute. Underlying cloud not included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Volume discount above 40 vCPU / 80 GB RAM. Adds premium support, advanced RBAC, SAML SSO, custom alerts and on-prem installation.

caveats: Platform fee only: requested vCPU $0.019/h, memory $0.009/GB-h, minute prorated. Website monthly $13/$6 are rounded illustrative numbers. Underlying AWS/Azure/GCP NOT included; over 40vCPU/80GB negotiated discounts. Nonprofit 50% off conditional. Do not rank software surcharge as all-in compute.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.
Startup deal through investors (e.g. Y Combinator, a16z speedrun) or by application. Terms are not public. Cloud credits can pay the underlying AWS/Azure/GCP bill.
